question: Which of the following coaches received the Dronacharya Award for para-shooting in 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Subhash Rana**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Subhash Rana** was awarded the prestigious **Dronacharya Award** in **2025** for his exceptional coaching in the field of **para-shooting**.
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** is conferred annually by the Government of India to recognize outstanding coaches who have contributed significantly to the development of athletes and sports in India.
 
• **Subhash Rana's** guidance and mentorship have played a pivotal role in the success of Indian para-shooters at both national and international levels.
 
• Under his training, several Indian para-shooters have achieved remarkable success, including medals in the **Paralympic Games**, **World Shooting Championships**, and other global competitions.
 
• His dedication to nurturing talent in the para-sports community highlights the importance of inclusivity and equal opportunities in the field of sports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Dronacharya Award:**

 
 
• The **Dronacharya Award** was instituted in **1985** by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports, Government of India.
 
• It recognizes coaches who have consistently produced outstanding sportspersons and brought laurels to the country.
 
• The award includes a **bronze statuette of Dronacharya**, a certificate, ceremonial dress, and a cash prize.
 
 
 
• **Para-shooting:**
 
 
• **Para-shooting** is an adaptive sport in shooting for athletes with physical impairments.
 
• It is governed by the **International Paralympic Committee (IPC)** and follows the rules of the **International Shooting Sport Federation (ISSF)**.
 
• Events include **rifle** and **pistol shooting**, conducted in categories such as SH1 and SH2, based on the level of physical impairment.
 
 
 
• **Achievements of Indian Para-Shooters:**
 
 
• India has produced several successful para-shooters, such as **Avani Lekhara**, who won a gold medal in the **Tokyo Paralympics 2020**.
 
• Other notable para-shooters include **Singhraj Adhana** and **Manish Narwal**, who have brought glory to India on the global stage.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Coaching in Sports:**
 
 
• Coaches play a critical role in identifying and nurturing sports talent and ensuring athletes reach their full potential.
 
• They provide technical training, psychological support, and strategic insights to help athletes perform at their best.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Other Notable Dronacharya Awardees:**

 
 
• **Deepali Deshpande:** A renowned shooting coach, primarily focused on mainstream shooting events.
 
• **Sandeep Sangwan:** Known for his contributions to wrestling coaching in India.
 
• **S Muralidharan:** Recognized for his coaching in athletics.
 
 
 
• **Para-Sports in India:**
 
 
• The **Paralympic Committee of India (PCI)** is the national governing body for para-sports in India.
 
• India has significantly improved its performance in para-sports, with increased investment in facilities, training, and support for para-athletes.
